acquiredutils.gui.title: AcquiredUtils Settings
acquiredutils.gui.desc.slot_lock: Protect inventory slots from accidental changes.
acquiredutils.gui.desc.item_pickup_notif: Show colored notifications for recognized rare item pickups.

acquiredutils.gui.desc.edit_hud: Choose where pickup notifications appear on your screen.

acquiredutils.gui.desc.rarity_circle_opa: Adjust how visible the rarity circle is while keeping the item fully readable.

acquiredutils.gui.desc.keybind_inventory: Press this key while your player inventory is open to search item names and highlight matching slots.
